sentences.en: The kākāpō is a nocturnal, flightless parrot that is critically endangered and one of New Zealand’s unique treasures
sentences.zh: 鸮鹦鹉是一种不会飞的夜行鹦鹉，已属极危物种，也是新西兰特有的珍宝之一。

sentences.en: The kākāpō, also known as the owl parrot, is a large, forest-dwelling bird, with a pale owl-like face.
sentences.zh: 鸮鹦鹉又叫猫头鹰鹦鹉，是一种生活在森林里的大型鸟类，浅色的脸很像猫头鹰。

sentences.en: Up to 64 cm in length, it has predominantly yellow-green feathers, forward-facing eyes, a large grey beak, large blue feet, and relatively short wings and tail.
sentences.zh: 它体长可达64厘米，羽毛以黄绿色为主。它双眼朝前，喙大而灰，双脚大而呈蓝色，翅膀和尾巴相对较短。

sentences.en: It is the world’s only flightless parrot, and is also possibly one of the world’s longest-living birds, with a reported lifespan of up to 100 years.
sentences.zh: 它是世界上唯一不会飞的鹦鹉，也可能是世界上最长寿的鸟类之一，据报道寿命可达100年。

sentences.en: Kākāpō are solitary birds and tend to occupy the same home range for many years.
sentences.zh: 鸮鹦鹉是独居鸟类，往往多年都在同一片区域内活动。

sentences.en: They forage on the ground and climb high into trees.
sentences.zh: 它们在地面觅食，也会爬到树上很高的地方。

sentences.en: They often leap from trees and flap their wings, but at best manage a controlled descent to the ground.
sentences.zh: 它们常从树上一跃而下，拍打着翅膀，但最多也只能控制着身体降落到地面。

sentences.en: They are entirely vegetarian, with their diet including the leaves, roots and bark of trees as well as bulbs, and fern fronds.
sentences.zh: 它们只吃植物，食物包括树叶、树根、树皮，也包括植物的鳞茎和蕨叶。

sentences.en: Kākāpō breed in summer and autumn, but only in years when food is plentiful.
sentences.zh: 鸮鹦鹉在夏秋两季繁殖，但只有食物充足的年份才会繁殖。

sentences.en: Males play no part in incubation or chick-rearing – females alone incubate eggs and feed the chicks.
sentences.zh: 雄鸟既不孵卵也不育雏，孵卵和给雏鸟喂食全由雌鸟负责。

sentences.en: The 1–4 eggs are laid in soil, which is repeatedly turned over before and during incubation.
sentences.zh: 这1至4枚卵产在土里。孵卵前和孵卵期间，这些土会被反复翻动。

sentences.en: The female kākāpō has to spend long periods away from the nest searching for food, which leaves the unattended eggs and chicks particularly vulnerable to predators.
sentences.zh: 雌鸟不得不长时间离巢觅食，这使得缺少照看的鸟卵和雏鸟尤其容易受到捕食者的袭击。

sentences.en: Before humans arrived, kākāpō were common throughout New Zealand’s forests.
sentences.zh: 在人类到来之前，鸮鹦鹉在新西兰各地的森林里都很常见。

sentences.en: However, this all changed with the arrival of the first Polynesian settlers about 700 years ago.
sentences.zh: 然而，大约700年前，随着第一批波利尼西亚定居者到来，这一切都改变了。

sentences.en: For the early settlers, the flightless kākāpō was easy prey.
sentences.zh: 对早期定居者来说，不会飞的鸮鹦鹉是很容易捕获的猎物。

sentences.en: They ate its meat and used its feathers to make soft cloaks.
sentences.zh: 他们吃鸮鹦鹉的肉，还用它的羽毛制作柔软的披风。

sentences.en: With them came the Polynesian dog and rat, which also preyed on kākāpō.
sentences.zh: 随定居者而来的还有波利尼西亚犬和波利尼西亚鼠，它们也捕食鸮鹦鹉。

sentences.en: By the time European colonisers arrived in the early 1800s, kākāpō had become confined to the central North Island and forested parts of the South Island.
sentences.zh: 到19世纪初欧洲殖民者抵达时，鸮鹦鹉已只分布在北岛中部和南岛有森林覆盖的地区。

sentences.en: The fall in kākāpō numbers was accelerated by European colonisation.
sentences.zh: 欧洲人的殖民活动使鸮鹦鹉的数量下降得更快。

sentences.en: A great deal of habitat was lost through forest clearance, and introduced species such as deer depleted the remaining forests of food.
sentences.zh: 森林砍伐造成大片栖息地丧失，而鹿等被引入的物种又大量消耗了剩余森林中的食物。

sentences.en: Other predators such as cats, stoats and two more species of rat were also introduced.
sentences.zh: 猫、白鼬以及另外两种鼠类等捕食者也被引入了当地。

sentences.en: The kākāpō were in serious trouble.
sentences.zh: 鸮鹦鹉的生存陷入了严重危机。

sentences.en: In 1894, the New Zealand government launched its first attempt to save the kākāpō.
sentences.zh: 1894年，新西兰政府首次采取行动，试图挽救鸮鹦鹉。

sentences.en: Conservationist Richard Henry led an effort to relocate several hundred of the birds to predator-free Resolution Island in Fiordland.
sentences.zh: 自然保护人士理查德·亨利牵头开展了一项行动，试图将数百只鸮鹦鹉迁往峡湾地区没有捕食者的雷索卢申岛。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the island didn’t remain predator free – stoats arrived within six years, eventually destroying the kākāpō population.
sentences.zh: 可惜，岛上没有捕食者的局面未能持续。白鼬在六年内就来到岛上，最终使岛上的鸮鹦鹉种群灭绝。

sentences.en: By the mid-1900s, the kākāpō was practically a lost species.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪中叶，鸮鹦鹉已几乎灭绝。

sentences.en: Only a few clung to life in the most isolated parts of New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 只有少数几只在新西兰最偏远的地方勉强活了下来。

sentences.en: From 1949 to 1973, the newly formed New Zealand Wildlife Service made over 60 expeditions to find kākāpō, focusing mainly on Fiordland.
sentences.zh: 1949年至1973年间，新成立的新西兰野生动物管理局为寻找鸮鹦鹉开展了超过60次考察，主要集中在峡湾地区。

sentences.en: Six were caught, but there were no females amongst them and all but one died within a few months of captivity.
sentences.zh: 共捕获了六只鸮鹦鹉，但其中没有雌鸟，而且除一只外，其余都在被圈养后的几个月内死去。

sentences.en: In 1974, a new initiative was launched, and by 1977, 18 more kākāpō were found in Fiordland.
sentences.zh: 1974年，一项新行动启动。到1977年，人们又在峡湾地区发现了18只鸮鹦鹉。

sentences.en: However, there were still no females.
sentences.zh: 然而，仍然没有雌鸟。

sentences.en: In 1977, a large population of males was spotted in Rakiura – a large island free from stoats, ferrets and weasels.
sentences.zh: 1977年，人们在拉奇乌拉岛发现了数量众多的雄性鸮鹦鹉。这是一座没有白鼬、雪貂和伶鼬的大岛。

sentences.en: There were about 200 individuals, and in 1980 it was confirmed females were also present.
sentences.zh: 岛上约有200只鸮鹦鹉；到了1980年，人们证实岛上也有雌鸟。

sentences.en: These birds have been the foundation of all subsequent work in managing the species.
sentences.zh: 这群鸟构成了此后所有鸮鹦鹉管护工作的基础。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, predation by feral cats on Rakiura Island led to a rapid decline in kākāpō numbers.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，由于遭到岛上野化猫的捕食，拉奇乌拉岛的鸮鹦鹉数量迅速下降。

sentences.en: As a result, during 1980–97, the surviving population was evacuated to three island sanctuaries: Codfish Island, Maud Island and Little Barrier Island.
sentences.zh: 因此，1980年至1997年间，幸存的鸮鹦鹉种群被转移安置，目的地是三处海岛保护区，即科德菲什岛、莫德岛和小巴里尔岛。

sentences.en: However, breeding success was hard to achieve.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些鸟很难成功繁殖。

sentences.en: Rats were found to be a major predator of kākāpō chicks and an insufficient number of chicks survived to offset adult mortality.
sentences.zh: 人们发现，鼠类是鸮鹦鹉雏鸟的主要捕食者之一，而存活下来的雏鸟数量不足以抵消成鸟死亡造成的损失。

sentences.en: By 1995, although at least 12 chicks had been produced on the islands, only three had survived.
sentences.zh: 到1995年，虽然这些岛上至少孵出了12只雏鸟，但只有三只活了下来。

sentences.en: The kākāpō population had dropped to 51 birds.
sentences.zh: 鸮鹦鹉的数量已经降至51只。

sentences.en: The critical situation prompted an urgent review of kākāpō management in New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 这一危急局面促使新西兰紧急重新评估鸮鹦鹉的管护工作。

sentences.en: In 1996, a new Recovery Plan was launched, together with a specialist advisory group called the Kākāpō Scientific and Technical Advisory Committee and a higher amount of funding.
sentences.zh: 1996年，一项新的种群恢复计划启动，同时成立了名为“鸮鹦鹉科学技术咨询委员会”的专家咨询小组，经费也有所增加。

sentences.en: Renewed steps were taken to control predators on the three islands.
sentences.zh: 人们再次采取措施，控制这三座岛上的捕食者。

sentences.en: Cats were eradicated from Little Barrier Island in 1980, and possums were eradicated from Codfish Island by 1986.
sentences.zh: 1980年，小巴里尔岛上的猫被彻底清除；到1986年，科德菲什岛上的袋貂也已被彻底清除。

sentences.en: However, the population did not start to increase until rats were removed from all three islands, and the birds were more intensively managed.
sentences.zh: 然而，直到三座岛上的鼠类都被清除、对鸮鹦鹉的管护也更加密集，种群数量才开始增加。

sentences.en: This involved moving the birds between islands, supplementary feeding of adults and rescuing and hand-raising any failing chicks.
sentences.zh: 具体措施包括在各岛之间转移鸮鹦鹉，给成鸟补充食物，并救助所有体弱的雏鸟，由人工抚育。

sentences.en: After the first five years of the Recovery Plan, the population was on target.
sentences.zh: 恢复计划实施五年后，种群数量的发展符合既定目标。

sentences.en: By 2000, five new females had been produced, and the total population had grown to 62 birds.
sentences.zh: 到2000年，已经繁育出五只新的雌鸟，种群总数增至62只。

sentences.en: For the first time, there was cautious optimism for the future of kākāpō and by June 2020, a total of 210 birds was recorded.
sentences.zh: 人们第一次对鸮鹦鹉的未来持谨慎乐观的态度。到2020年6月，共记录到210只鸮鹦鹉。

sentences.en: Today, kākāpō management continues to be guided by the kākāpō Recovery Plan.
sentences.zh: 如今，鸮鹦鹉的保护管理工作仍在这项种群恢复计划的指导下开展。

sentences.en: Its key goals are: minimise the loss of genetic diversity in the kākāpō population, restore or maintain sufficient habitat to accommodate the expected increase in the kākāpō population, and ensure stakeholders continue to be fully engaged in the preservation of the species.
sentences.zh: 其主要目标是：尽量减少鸮鹦鹉种群遗传多样性的丧失；恢复或维持足够的栖息地，为鸮鹦鹉种群的预期增长留出空间；确保各利益相关方继续充分参与这一物种的保护。

questions.question: There are other parrots that share the kakapo’s inability to fly.
questions.logic: 题干的 other parrots 表示鸮鹦鹉以外还有不会飞的鹦鹉。原文的限定词 only 表明它是世界上唯一不会飞的鹦鹉，两者直接矛盾，因此选 FALSE。只读到第一句的 flightless 还不足以判断，还有没有其他种类才是判题关键。
